title: Across a shadow boundary
blurb: A page-wide glossary highlights terms in the light DOM and inside two components' shadow roots; toggles test which ::highlight rules paint inside the shadow trees and what getComputedStyle reports.
question: Does a document-level ::highlight(*) rule paint highlights inside shadow trees, does the component's own rule win, and does getComputedStyle report the painted style?
result: Document ::highlight(*) paints inside the shadow trees, but getComputedStyle reports initial values for that shadow text (transparent background). A document ::highlight(glossary) rule paints there and is reported correctly. The component's own ::highlight(*) wins inside the component and is reported correctly. A second mismatch: with a document ::highlight(glossary) rule and the component's ::highlight(*) both on, the shadow text paints with the document named rule while getComputedStyle reports the component's universal rule.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (Linux, headless, no flags) on 2026-11-27

friction.summary: getComputedStyle(shadowEl, '::highlight(x)') reports initial values when the only matching rule is a document-level ::highlight(*), although that rule paints the shadow-tree text.
friction.repro: Document sheet ::highlight(*) { background-color: rgb(0,200,0) }; register a Highlight over text inside an open shadow root; screenshot shows green, getComputedStyle(p, '::highlight(x)').backgroundColor is rgba(0, 0, 0, 0). With ::highlight(x) instead of * both agree.
friction.workaround: Verify highlight styling inside components with screenshots, or use a named rule where computed-style readback matters.

friction.summary: Inside a shadow tree, a document-level named ::highlight(x) rule wins in paint over the component's own ::highlight(*), but getComputedStyle reports the component rule.
friction.repro: On this page turn on 'Document: ::highlight(glossary)' and 'Inside each card: ::highlight(*)': card terms paint blue, the table reports the card's rose rule.
friction.workaround: Screenshot-test highlight styling in components; avoid relying on getComputedStyle for highlight pseudo-elements in shadow trees.
